```{r}
# Packages 
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(ggplot2)

conflict_prefer("filter", "dplyr")

```
#1. Data Import & Cleaning
```{r}
# Read Data
file_path <- "data <- read.csv("data/eye_tracking_anonymised.csv")"
data <- read.csv(file_path)

# Convert necessary columns to numeric 
data <- data %>%
  mutate(across(c("Total_duration_of_fixations",
                  "Average_duration_of_fixations",
                  "Wordcount",
                  "Number_of_fixations",
                  "Average_pupil_diameter"), as.numeric))

# Filter AOI == "SUB" and derive factors
data_sub <- data %>%
  filter(AOI == "SUB") %>%
  mutate(
    Subtitle_Type = case_when(
      str_detect(Media, "ST")  ~ "ST",
      str_detect(Media, "SDH") ~ "SDH",
      str_detect(Media, "LC")  ~ "AC",   # LC -> AC HERE
      TRUE ~ "Unknown"
    ),
    Modality = case_when(
      str_detect(Media, "^C") ~ "Intralingual",
      str_detect(Media, "^E") ~ "Interlingual",
      TRUE ~ "Unknown"
    ),
    Participant = as.factor(Participant)
  )

# Keep only valid levels 
data_sub <- data_sub %>%
  filter(Subtitle_Type %in% c("ST", "SDH", "AC"),
         Modality %in% c("Intralingual", "Interlingual")) %>%
  mutate(
    Modality = factor(Modality, levels = c("Intralingual", "Interlingual")),
    Subtitle_Type = factor(Subtitle_Type, levels = c("ST", "AC", "SDH"))
  )
```

#2. Measures Used
```{r}
# Measures (REMOVED Number_of_Visits)
eye_tracking_measures <- c("Total_duration_of_fixations",
                           "Average_duration_of_fixations",
                           "Number_of_fixations",
                           "Average_pupil_diameter")
```

#3. Descriptive Statistics
```{r}
descriptive_stats <- function(df, group_cols, value_cols) {
  df %>%
    group_by(across(all_of(group_cols))) %>%
    summarise(across(all_of(value_cols),
                     list(mean = ~ mean(., na.rm = TRUE),
                          sd = ~ sd(., na.rm = TRUE),
                          median = ~ median(., na.rm = TRUE),
                          min = ~ min(., na.rm = TRUE),
                          max = ~ max(., na.rm = TRUE)),
                     .names = "{.col}_{.fn}"),
              .groups = "drop")
}

#Convert Total_duration_of_fixations to seconds
data_sub <- data_sub %>%
  mutate(Total_duration_of_fixations = Total_duration_of_fixations / 1000)

descriptive_stats_sub <- descriptive_stats(
  data_sub,
  group_cols = c("Modality", "Subtitle_Type"),
  value_cols = eye_tracking_measures
)

knitr::kable(descriptive_stats_sub, digits = 3)
```

#4. Assumption Checks (Exploratory)
#4.1 Normality (Shapiro-Wilk)
```{r}
check_normality <- function(df, columns) {
  setNames(lapply(columns, function(col) shapiro.test(df[[col]])), columns)
}

normality_results <- check_normality(data_sub, eye_tracking_measures)
normality_results
```

#4.2 Homoscedasticity (Levene)
```{r}
homoscedasticity_results <- lapply(
  eye_tracking_measures,
  function(var) car::leveneTest(as.formula(paste(var, "~ Subtitle_Type")), data = data_sub)
)
names(homoscedasticity_results) <- eye_tracking_measures
homoscedasticity_results
```
#4.3 Collinearity (VIF example)
```{r}
predictors <- c("Modality", "Subtitle_Type", "Wordcount")

vif_model <- lm(
  Total_duration_of_fixations ~ .,
  data = data_sub[, c(predictors, "Total_duration_of_fixations")]
)

car::vif(vif_model)
```
#5. GAM Model Selection (AIC)
```{r}
aic_results <- list()

for (measure in eye_tracking_measures) {
  aic_steps <- list()

  gam1 <- gam(as.formula(paste(measure, "~ 1")), data = data_sub, method = "REML")
  aic_steps[["gam1"]] <- AIC(gam1)

  gam2 <- gam(as.formula(paste(measure, "~ Modality + Subtitle_Type")),
              data = data_sub, method = "REML")
  aic_steps[["gam2"]] <- AIC(gam2)

  gam3 <- gam(as.formula(paste(measure, "~ Modality * Subtitle_Type")),
              data = data_sub, method = "REML")
  aic_steps[["gam3"]] <- AIC(gam3)

  gam4 <- gam(as.formula(paste(measure, "~ Modality * Subtitle_Type + s(Wordcount)")),
              data = data_sub, method = "REML")
  aic_steps[["gam4"]] <- AIC(gam4)

  gam5 <- gam(as.formula(paste(measure, "~ Modality * Subtitle_Type + s(Wordcount) + s(Participant, bs='re')")),
              data = data_sub, method = "REML")
  aic_steps[["gam5"]] <- AIC(gam5)

  aic_results[[measure]] <- aic_steps
}

aic_df <- do.call(rbind, lapply(aic_results, function(x) as.data.frame(t(unlist(x)))))
rownames(aic_df) <- eye_tracking_measures
knitr::kable(aic_df, digits = 1)
```

#6. Fit Final GAMs + Diagnostics
```{r}
# Set reference levels 
data_sub$Modality <- relevel(data_sub$Modality, ref = "Intralingual")
data_sub$Subtitle_Type <- relevel(data_sub$Subtitle_Type, ref = "ST")

gam_models <- list()

for (measure in eye_tracking_measures) {
  formula <- as.formula(paste(measure, "~ Modality * Subtitle_Type + s(Wordcount) + s(Participant, bs='re')"))
  gam_models[[measure]] <- gam(formula, data = data_sub, method = "REML")
  cat("Model fitted:", measure, "\n")
}

# Summaries + checks
for (measure in eye_tracking_measures) {
  cat("\n--- Summary:", measure, "---\n")
  print(summary(gam_models[[measure]]))
  print(gam.check(gam_models[[measure]]))
}
```

#7. Visualisation (itsadug)
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

modality_levels <- c("Intralingual", "Interlingual")
subtitle_type_levels <- c("ST", "AC", "SDH")

type_colors <- c(
  "ST"  = "#00BFC4",
  "AC"  = "#F8766D",
  "SDH" = "#999999"
)

for (measure in eye_tracking_measures) {
  for (modality in modality_levels) {

    model <- gam_models[[measure]]

    wc_seq <- seq(min(data_sub$Wordcount, na.rm = TRUE),
                  max(data_sub$Wordcount, na.rm = TRUE),
                  length.out = 100)

    newdat <- expand.grid(
      Wordcount = wc_seq,
      Modality = factor(modality, levels = levels(data_sub$Modality)),
      Subtitle_Type = factor(subtitle_type_levels,
                             levels = levels(data_sub$Subtitle_Type)),
      Participant = data_sub$Participant[1]
    )

    pred <- predict(model, newdata = newdat, se.fit = TRUE,
                    exclude = "s(Participant)")

    plot_df <- newdat %>%
      mutate(
        fit   = pred$fit,
        se    = pred$se.fit,
        lower = fit - 1.96 * se,
        upper = fit + 1.96 * se
      )

    measure_label <- gsub("_", " ", measure)

    p <- ggplot(
      plot_df,
      aes(x = Wordcount, y = fit,
          colour = Subtitle_Type,
          fill   = Subtitle_Type,
          group  = Subtitle_Type)
    ) +
      geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper),
                  alpha = 0.25, colour = NA) +
      geom_line(linewidth = 0.9) +
      scale_colour_manual(values = type_colors) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = type_colors) +
      labs(
        title = paste0(measure_label, " | ", modality),
        x = "Word Count",
        y = paste0("Predicted ", measure_label),
        colour = NULL,
        fill = NULL
      ) +
     theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
theme(
  legend.position = "top",
  panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
  panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),

  #axis
  axis.line.x = element_line(colour = "gray", linewidth = 0.6),
  axis.line.y = element_line(colour = "gray", linewidth = 0.6)
)

    print(p)
  }
}
```
